resolution_method: Read applicable Doc29/17/06/08, current008 scope/ARP, Doc32 policy catalog, current P2-017/019/016 work acceptance and existing003-005 inventory conventions. No source authority, policy or legal value was invented.

requirements.requirement_excerpt: Every authoritative resource/data class records owning domain, purpose, sensitivity, stores, recipients/processors, retention class, residency, privacy capabilities and protection.
requirements.applicability: Applies to five new TOTP tables, linked session/proof fields, provider seed payload and transient disclosure/output. Inventory above records implemented fields and unselected production profiles.

requirements.requirement_excerpt: An approved policy reference precedes ACTIVE processing; retention is class/jurisdiction/purpose driven. Before production, policy defines trigger, periods/event rule, action, holds and evidence. Canonical data lifecycle is independent of business status; holds block destructive purge.
requirements.applicability: ExpiresAt or DISABLED cannot be represented as physical erasure. Approved values are not required to be invented now; usable owner lifecycle mechanics and evidence remain a pre-production requirement.

requirements.requirement_excerpt: TOTP uses compliant storage/lifecycle and becomes active only after first code; Admin/Support must never expose TOTP seeds.
requirements.applicability: Seed is in immutable provider record; first activation is native+atomic, normal responses are metadata only, one-time authorized disclosure is User-only. No general privacy-export entitlement to seed follows.

requirements.requirement_excerpt: All secrets are resolved via secret-store abstraction; secrets do not belong in source, logs or committed configuration.
requirements.applicability: Real OpenBao adapter and finite scoped identity are reused; no database seed, custom permanent DP seed keyring or bootstrap credential file is selected.

requirements.requirement_excerpt: Authentication secrets and sensitive security evidence are RESTRICTED; classification controls logging, export, retention, encryption, access and test use.
requirements.applicability: Salted used-code verifiers and source digests remain restricted; fixture or provider acceptance is not production privacy/legal authorization.

requirements.requirement_excerpt: Lifecycle metadata denies disabled factors immediately; provider retirement/purge follows explicit retention policy.
requirements.applicability: Immediate verification disable is implemented. Provider physical retirement is not; inactive/expired/abandoned references must not be described as deleted.

requirements.requirement_excerpt: Retention/Privacy/Processor/Residency are versioned policy families with identity, effective interval, lineage and approval evidence.
requirements.applicability: Nonempty processing/retention reference strings in a test profile do not prove a production Processing Governance Contract or residency approval.

actual_physical_retention_limits.scenario: After the last successful verification or after disabling the factor, no later successful acceptance occurs. Expired verifier rows persist.
actual_physical_retention_limits.implemented: On-success same-generation deletion only; timestamp filters stop replay entries affecting future acceptance after their horizon.
actual_physical_retention_limits.not_implemented: Periodic bounded expired-row sweep or owner retention action independent of successful authentication.

actual_physical_retention_limits.scenario: User abandons or completes the flow and never returns. Validity/recovery ends, but metadata is not physically purged or necessarily transitioned to stored EXPIRED.
actual_physical_retention_limits.implemented: Server rejects expired use/recovery and retains immutable original/result references.
actual_physical_retention_limits.not_implemented: TOTP expiry/purge maintenance entry point with approved metadata lifecycle/hold policy.

actual_physical_retention_limits.scenario: Generation is disabled or an inactive PREPARING/AWAITING_FIRST_CODE enrollment is abandoned. Seed remains in its pinned provider version.
actual_physical_retention_limits.implemented: Metadata denies verification or disclosure when source/operation is inactive, disabled, expired or already claimed.
actual_physical_retention_limits.not_implemented: ITotpSeedStore retirement/delete API or explicit owner-policy reconciliation/purge worker.

ownership_and_timing.p2_019: Owns approved typed Identity runtime configuration and governed publication/production composition. Does not itself implement every TOTP purge worker.
ownership_and_timing.p2_017: Owns end-to-end FRD security/privacy conformance and depends on008/019; appropriate coordinating acceptance follow-up for proving retention/hold/deletion behavior before production.
ownership_and_timing.p2_016: Current authoritative acceptance covers notification/audit/post-commit integration only. Earlier004 inventory text mentioning general maintenance scheduling is insufficient authority to silently assign all TOTP cleanup here.
ownership_and_timing.current_008: Current local inactive slice supplies validity and immediate security lifecycle; exact production retention/profile/provider remains unselected. No selected maximum-deletion rule is shown violated, so no automatic current008/Product blocker is created.

governed_followup.implementation_owner: Identity in existing008/shared-provider scope, or a governed later revision if that ownership has closed.
governed_followup.approved_inputs_owner: TUN-P2-019 supplies approved trigger/action/hold configuration; no duration or default is selected here.
governed_followup.timing: Must be implemented and actually verified before production activation. It does not block independent authorized local development.
